common_conditions: TS23.501 V19.8.0; GBR QoS Flow; Notification control without Alternative QoS Profiles
Application traffic can adapt to QoS changes
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Only enable when its parameter is set in the PCF-provided PCC rule bound to this flow; this optional GBR mechanism can be used when application traffic can adapt to QoS changes.

conditions: NG-RAN cannot fulfil GFBR, PDB or PER
Assessment considers Averaging Window and, for Delay-critical GBR, MDBV
If NG-RAN has received PSDB and PSER and applies PDU Set QoS handling in a direction, use PSDB/PSER instead of PDB/PER for that direction; otherwise retain PDB/PER
claims.conclusion: Notify SMF and keep flow unless specific RAN conditions require resource release, e.g. radio link failure or internal congestion; should try to fulfil the profile again.

limitations: Detailed PDU Set behavior beyond the stated directional substitution is not covered.
Alternative QoS Profiles and complete restoration/PCF/AF signaling are not covered.
